system.text:
Creatures of Shadow and Dust have two distinct aspects—a spirit shadow and some material vestige of their former life. The shadow is its active and “living” half. It is a physical manifestation and can be harmed by steel and fire. However, it cannot be permanently destroyed. If dealt a Mortal Wound or if incapacitated, the shadow dissipates. It reforms near its dust half in days equal to 10 minus Health. The other aspect of the creature is the dust: a corpse, a vessel of ashes, a skull or some other relic of a life past. In order to completely destroy this creature, the dust must be dragged into the morning sun and a Minor Miracle performed on it.

Type: Dt. Cost: 9 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 527
